disclaimer: General guidance for the EduVest prototype. Not the bank's official terms. Examples are fictional.

full_name.explanation: Your complete legal name, exactly as printed on your academic marks card.
full_name.where_to_find: Top of your marks card or on your admission letter.
common_mistakes: Using a short name or nickname.
Spelling it differently from the marks card, which causes a mismatch when the document is checked.

father_name.where_to_find: Marks card, school certificate or birth certificate.
common_mistakes: Writing only initials instead of the full name.

mother_name.where_to_find: Marks card, school certificate or birth certificate.
common_mistakes: Writing only initials instead of the full name.

date_of_birth.explanation: Your date of birth as shown in your official records.
date_of_birth.where_to_find: Birth certificate, school certificate or Aadhaar card.
common_mistakes: Swapping the day and the month.
Giving a date that does not match your documents.

gender.explanation: Your gender as per your records. Choose Male, Female or Other.
common_mistakes: Choosing an option that differs from your identity documents.

marital_status.explanation: Whether you are single or married at present.
marital_status.where_to_find: No document needed. Answer based on your current status.
common_mistakes: Choosing Other when Single or Married applies.

nationality.explanation: The country of which you are a citizen.
common_mistakes: Entering your state or religion instead of your nationality.

category.explanation: Your social category as per your caste certificate, if you have one. Choose General, OBC, SC or ST.
category.where_to_find: Caste certificate issued by the government.
common_mistakes: Choosing a reserved category without a valid certificate.

aadhaar_number.explanation: Your 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI.
common_mistakes: Entering fewer or more than 12 digits.
Entering your mobile number or PAN here.

pan_number.explanation: Permanent Account Number, a 10-character tax ID: five letters, then four digits, then one letter. Students may not have one, so it is optional.
pan_number.where_to_find: Your PAN card or income tax documents.
common_mistakes: Typing small letters or adding spaces.
Entering your Aadhaar number here.

disability_status.explanation: Whether you have a recognised disability. This is optional. Say Yes only if you have a disability certificate.
disability_status.where_to_find: Disability certificate, if you have one.
common_mistakes: Answering Yes without a certificate.

mobile_number.explanation: Your 10-digit mobile number where the bank can reach you.
common_mistakes: Adding +91 or a leading zero.
Entering a landline number.

alternate_mobile.explanation: A second number, such as a parent's, to reach you if your main number is unavailable. Optional.
alternate_mobile.where_to_find: Ask a family member for their number.
common_mistakes: Repeating the main mobile number.

email.explanation: Your email address, used for application updates.
common_mistakes: Missing the @ symbol.
Misspelling the domain, for example gmial.com.

current_address_line1.explanation: House or flat number, building name and street where you live now.
current_address_line1.where_to_find: Your current residence or a recent utility bill.
common_mistakes: Leaving out the house or flat number.
Repeating the whole of line 1.

current_city.explanation: The city or town where you live now.
common_mistakes: Writing the district or state in this field.

current_state.explanation: The state where you live now.
common_mistakes: Using a short code such as KA.

current_pincode.explanation: The 6-digit postal code of your current address.
current_pincode.where_to_find: Your address proof or any letter delivered to you.
common_mistakes: Entering 5 or 7 digits.
Starting with a zero.

permanent_address_same.explanation: Say Yes if your permanent home address is the same as the address where you live now.
permanent_address_same.where_to_find: Compare with the address on your Aadhaar card.
common_mistakes: Saying Yes when your documents show a different address.

permanent_address.explanation: The full address of your permanent home, including area, city, state and PIN code.
common_mistakes: Leaving out the PIN code or the city.

institution_name.explanation: The full name of the college or university where you will study.
common_mistakes: Using only an abbreviation.
Entering the university name when the college name is asked.

institution_type.explanation: Whether the institution is Government, Private or a Deemed university.
institution_type.where_to_find: Admission letter or the institution's website.
common_mistakes: Choosing Government for an aided private college.

course_name.explanation: The full name of the course you will study.
course_name.example: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering
common_mistakes: Entering only the branch without the degree.

course_level.explanation: The level of the course: Undergraduate, Postgraduate, Diploma or PhD.
common_mistakes: Choosing Postgraduate for an integrated or undergraduate course.

specialisation.explanation: Your branch or area of specialisation within the course. Optional.
common_mistakes: Repeating the course name.

course_duration_years.explanation: How many years the course lasts in total.
course_duration_years.where_to_find: Admission letter or the course prospectus.
common_mistakes: Entering months instead of years.

course_start_year.explanation: The year in which your course starts.
common_mistakes: Entering the year you are applying for the loan if the course starts in a different year.

study_country.explanation: Choose India if you will study within India, or Abroad if you will study outside India.
common_mistakes: Choosing India for an overseas campus.

country_name.explanation: The country where you will study. Asked only if you chose Abroad.
common_mistakes: Entering the city instead of the country.

admission_status.explanation: Confirmed means you already have an admission or offer letter. Awaiting means the result is still pending.
common_mistakes: Choosing Confirmed before receiving the letter.

admission_type.explanation: How you got your seat: through an entrance exam, on merit based on marks, or through the college's management quota.
admission_type.where_to_find: Admission letter or counselling allotment letter.
common_mistakes: Choosing Merit for an entrance-based seat.

entrance_exam_name.explanation: The name of the entrance exam you took. Asked only for entrance-based admission.
entrance_exam_name.where_to_find: Entrance exam result or rank card.
common_mistakes: Writing the counselling name instead of the exam name.

entrance_exam_rank.explanation: The rank you got in the entrance exam.
common_mistakes: Entering your score instead of your rank.

qualifying_exam.explanation: The latest exam you passed that makes you eligible for this course.
common_mistakes: Choosing an older exam such as 10th.

board_or_university.explanation: The board or university that issued your qualifying marks card.
board_or_university.where_to_find: Printed at the top of the marks card.
common_mistakes: Entering your school or college name instead.

register_number.explanation: The unique number on your marks card that identifies you for that exam. It may differ from your roll number.
common_mistakes: Entering the roll number or hall ticket number.
Mixing up the letter O and the digit 0.

year_of_passing.explanation: The year in which you passed the qualifying exam.
common_mistakes: Entering the year you joined instead of the year you passed.

marks_obtained.explanation: The total marks you scored across all subjects.
marks_obtained.where_to_find: Total line on your marks card.
common_mistakes: Entering a percentage here.
Entering the marks of only one subject.

max_marks.explanation: The total maximum marks for all subjects together.
max_marks.where_to_find: Total line on your marks card.
common_mistakes: Entering the maximum of a single subject.

percentage.explanation: Worked out automatically as marks obtained divided by maximum marks, times 100. You only need to confirm it.
percentage.where_to_find: Printed on some marks cards. Otherwise it is calculated for you.
common_mistakes: Confusing percentage with CGPA.

class_obtained.explanation: The class or grade shown on your marks card. Optional.
class_obtained.where_to_find: Result line of your marks card.
common_mistakes: Choosing a class that does not match your percentage.

tenth_percentage.explanation: Your overall percentage in the 10th standard.
common_mistakes: Entering the 12th percentage here.

twelfth_percentage.explanation: Your overall percentage in 12th standard or PUC.
common_mistakes: Entering the 10th percentage here.

has_backlogs.explanation: A backlog is a subject you have not passed yet and must clear later.
has_backlogs.where_to_find: Your latest marks card or grade sheet.
common_mistakes: Answering No when a subject is still pending.

backlog_count.explanation: How many subjects are still pending. Asked only if you have backlogs.
backlog_count.where_to_find: Your latest marks card or grade sheet.
common_mistakes: Counting semesters instead of subjects.

tuition_fee_total.explanation: The total tuition fee for the entire course, not for one year.
tuition_fee_total.where_to_find: Fee structure in your admission letter.
common_mistakes: Entering only one year's fee.

hostel_fee_total.explanation: Total hostel or accommodation cost, including food, for the whole course. Enter 0 if you will live at home.
hostel_fee_total.where_to_find: Hostel fee details from the institution.
common_mistakes: Entering the monthly cost instead of the course total.

books_equipment_cost.explanation: Estimated cost of books, laptop, uniform and any lab or study equipment for the whole course.
books_equipment_cost.where_to_find: Course prospectus or the institution's list of requirements.
common_mistakes: Leaving out the laptop or equipment cost.

travel_cost.explanation: Estimated travel cost for the course, including flights and local travel. Asked only for study abroad.
travel_cost.where_to_find: Your own estimate from ticket prices.
common_mistakes: Entering a single trip when several are needed.

other_expenses.explanation: Any other costs such as exam fees, insurance or project work. Optional.
other_expenses.where_to_find: Fee structure or your own estimate.
common_mistakes: Repeating costs already entered above.

total_course_cost.explanation: Added up automatically from tuition, hostel, books, travel and other expenses.
common_mistakes: If the total looks wrong, check the individual costs above rather than the total.

scholarship_amount.explanation: Total scholarship or fee waiver you expect to receive, if any. Optional.
common_mistakes: Counting a scholarship that is not confirmed yet.

loan_amount_requested.explanation: The amount you want to borrow. It cannot be more than the course cost minus your margin money and any scholarship.
loan_amount_requested.where_to_find: Work it out from the course cost section.
common_mistakes: Asking for the full course cost without subtracting margin money and scholarship.

repayment_tenure_years.explanation: The number of years over which you would like to repay the loan.
repayment_tenure_years.where_to_find: Your own plan with your family.
common_mistakes: Entering months instead of years.

moratorium_acknowledged.explanation: A moratorium is a period when you do not pay EMIs, usually while you study and for a short time after. Tick to confirm you understand that repayment begins after it ends.
common_mistakes: Assuming interest is not charged during the moratorium.

margin_money_amount.explanation: Margin money is the part of the total cost that you or your family pay from your own funds instead of the loan.
margin_money_amount.where_to_find: Based on the savings your family will use.
common_mistakes: Entering the loan amount here by mistake.

margin_source.explanation: Where the margin money will come from: your own savings, family, or another source.
common_mistakes: Choosing Own savings when a parent is paying.

other_loans_for_education.explanation: Whether you have already taken any other loan for education.
common_mistakes: Answering No when a loan from another bank exists.

co_applicant_name.explanation: The full name of the parent or guardian who will share responsibility for repaying the loan.
common_mistakes: Entering the student's own name.

co_applicant_relationship.explanation: How the co-applicant is related to you, such as Father, Mother or Guardian.
common_mistakes: Choosing Other when Father or Mother applies.

co_applicant_dob.explanation: The co-applicant's date of birth. They must be at least 18 years old.
common_mistakes: Entering the student's date of birth.

co_applicant_pan.explanation: The co-applicant's 10-character PAN: five letters, four digits, then one letter.
co_applicant_pan.where_to_find: Their PAN card or income tax documents.
common_mistakes: Typing small letters or adding spaces.
Entering the student's PAN.
Entering the student's number.

co_applicant_occupation.explanation: What the co-applicant does for a living.
common_mistakes: Writing Retired or Housewife without any income details.

co_applicant_employer_or_business.explanation: The name of the co-applicant's employer or business.
co_applicant_employer_or_business.where_to_find: Salary slip, appointment letter or business registration.
common_mistakes: Entering only the job title.

co_applicant_annual_income.explanation: The co-applicant's total income for one year, before tax, in rupees.
co_applicant_annual_income.where_to_find: Salary slips, income tax return or income certificate.
common_mistakes: Entering monthly income instead of yearly.
Entering combined family income.

co_applicant_existing_emi.explanation: The total monthly EMI the co-applicant already pays on other loans. Enter 0 if there are none.
common_mistakes: Leaving it blank instead of entering 0.

collateral_offered.explanation: Collateral is property or a deposit you offer as security for the loan. Say Yes if you will offer any.
collateral_offered.where_to_find: Your family's property or deposit documents.
common_mistakes: Saying Yes without having the ownership documents.

collateral_type.explanation: The kind of collateral you will offer: property, fixed deposit, insurance policy or other.
common_mistakes: Choosing Property for a deposit receipt.

collateral_estimated_value.explanation: The approximate current market value of the collateral, in rupees.
common_mistakes: Entering the purchase price from many years ago.

guarantor_name.explanation: A person other than the co-applicant who promises to repay the loan if you cannot. Optional.
common_mistakes: Entering the co-applicant's name again.

declaration_info_true.explanation: Confirms that everything you entered is true and correct to the best of your knowledge.
declaration_info_true.example: Tick the box after reviewing your answers.
common_mistakes: Ticking without reviewing the summary.

declaration_consent_credit_check.explanation: Allows the bank to check the credit history of you and your co-applicant.
common_mistakes: Leaving it unticked, which prevents the application from being completed.

declaration_terms_accepted.explanation: Confirms that you have read and accept the loan terms and conditions.
common_mistakes: Accepting without reading the terms.

terms.moratorium: The period during which you do not have to pay EMIs, usually the course period plus a short time after it ends. Interest may still build up during this time.
terms.margin_money: The part of the total cost that the student or family pays from their own funds, so the loan covers only the rest.
terms.collateral: Property or a deposit offered to the bank as security for the loan.
terms.co_applicant: A parent or guardian who shares responsibility for repaying the loan with the student.
terms.guarantor: A person who promises to repay the loan if the borrower and co-applicant cannot.
terms.emi: Equated Monthly Installment: the fixed amount paid to the bank every month to repay a loan.
terms.backlog: A subject that has not been passed yet and must be cleared later.
terms.pan: Permanent Account Number: a 10-character tax identity number issued by the Income Tax Department.
terms.aadhaar: A 12-digit unique identity number issued by UIDAI.
terms.tenure: The total number of years over which a loan is repaid.
terms.readiness_summary: A final check showing which parts of the application are complete and which still need attention.
